notes.title: Patch Note（Rev:236 BuildID:13852823)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44452692/14a3c6082c83e68dc77c945e07e9e756e8b4a521.jpg[/img]
Thank you for playing Radiant Silvergun. We would also like to thank you for your feedback.
This update addresses the following issues.

[h2][b]Update[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Added TRAINING function
During training, we have implemented the following functions to make it easier to practice.
These functions can be changed at the start of training or at any time from the pause menu.

▼Demo Skip
You will be able to skip event scenes that are displayed every time.

▼Invincibility
Even if you come into contact with enemies, objects, or enemy bullets, you will not be treated as being hit.
Your aircraft will flash when hit.

▼Hyper Sword
You can optionally set the starting Hyper Sword Gauge. [/list]
[list][*]Adjusting screen display
The following changes have been made to the screen display.
▼Displaying INSERT COIN
▼NEW+OLD added to HUD display type
▼When the window size is maximized, it is now the size of the monitor resolution.
*After starting at 0%, open the menu while pressing RT and change to 100%, it is also possible to issue the Radiant Sword while the gauge remains at 100%.

When you maximize a window, it becomes borderless.
If you want to change back from borderless to windowed or change from windowed to borderless:
Press "F11" on your keyboard. [/list]
[list][*]SE adjustment
Adjusted the volume and timing of SE playback. [/list]
If you have any concerns after updating, please
We apologize for the inconvenience, but please contact us with a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2450820/discussions/0/3936769163105445986/][u]bug report[/u][/url] or [url=https://www.live-wire.co.jp/support][u]support[/u][/url].

Thank you for your continued support of Radiant Silvergun.

notes.title: Patch Note（Rev:224 BuildID:1361857)
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Radiant Silvergun.
We would also like to thank you for your feedback.

In this mini-update, we have addressed the following.

[h2][b]UPDATE[/b][/h2]

[list][*]Fixed bugs that occurred with some bosses
Despite clearly avoiding the attack from NASU during the boss "NASU" that appears during 2C,
Fixed an issue where in rare cases the player-unit would be treated as being hit by a bullet.[/list]
[list][*]Addresses issues that occur during actual play and when replaying replay data.
We have taken measures to address the issue where the game moves differently from the actual play when playing replay data.
Due to this modification, there may be a difference in the calculation of score addition.
Along with this, "v05" will be displayed in the replay data.[/list]
[list][*]When recording a game using Geforce Experience, the save destination folder name and file name may be changed.Response to phenomena that are generated with a name different from the original intention.

Up until now, when recording games using Geforce Experience,
Folder name and file name are originally generated with the name "Raidiant Silvergun"
We have confirmed a phenomenon where videos are saved in a folder named "Raven Squad."
To address this issue, by changing the game's executable file name,
I have made sure that the file is correctly saved in the folder called "Raidiant Silvergun".

From now on, the video will be saved in the folder named "Raidiant Silvergun".
Please note that videos taken before the update are saved in a folder named "Raven Squad".
If you have already recorded, please check your settings and manage the files.

Also, if the game does not start properly after this support, please restart STEAM and then
Please try "Verify integrity of game files".[/list]
If you have any concerns after updating, please
We apologize for the inconvenience, but please contact us with a bug report or support.
Thank you for your report.

Thank you for your continued support of Radiant Silvergun.

notes.title: Patch Notes (Rev:211 BuildID:13051456)
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Radiant Silvergun.
We would also like to thank you for your feedback.

In this mini-update, we have addressed the following:

[h2][b]Update[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Arrow keys can now be assigned using the keyboard
Arrow keys can be assigned by setting HELP & OPTIONS > KEYBORAD.
Regarding key assignment, you can set the target key using the left and right keys.
By pressing the OK button, you can make the assignment, then press the arrow key you want to correspond to and set it.。[/list]
[list][*]Added retry function
You can start over by selecting Retry from the pause menu during the game.
Arcade mode and story mode will restart from 3A.
Training mode allows you to start over from the beginning of a specified stage. [/list]
[list][*]Other adjustments
OPTIONS > SETTING > Changed the initial arrangement of filters on the game screen.
From "HI-RES+EFFECT" and "ALPHA+"
Changed to "HI-RES" and "MESH1".
Please try the screen display of your choice. [/list]

If you have any concerns after updating, please
We apologize for the inconvenience, but please contact us with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2450820/discussions/0/3936769163105445986/]Bug Report[/url] or [url=https://www.live-wire.co .jp/support]Support[/url]
Thank you for your report.

Thank you for your continued support of Radiant Silvergun.
